metadata.name: fact-race
metadata.description: Two analysts answer the same question. One can look things up; the other cannot. A judge scores accuracy.

goals: Answer the question more accurately than your opponent
Say plainly where your answer came from
spec.guidelines:
Two analysts are asked the same factual question: ${question,What is the current population of Iceland?,The question both analysts must answer}.

Scout can look things up on the web. Pundit cannot, and must answer from what it already knows. Neither of you may pretend otherwise: if you did not look something up, do not imply that you did.

Give your answer in one message: the answer itself, then one line saying how you arrived at it. Then wait. The judge rules after both have answered.
spec.restrictions: Do not claim a source you did not actually read. Do not answer for the other analyst.
